acceptance: Every BenchBox reader of Theseus review prose AND of review-verdict/review-gate status description text is inventoried (rg for the verdict heading, `Decision: **`, `**<Severity>**`, `review-verdict`, `review-defect`, `review-finding`, `availability: `, `startswith(`/`in description` on statuses, and the bot logins across scripts/, _project/scripts/, tools/, make/, Makefile, .github/) and each one is either migrated or recorded as not affected, in the PR body.

scripts/pr_landing.py:695 (live_commit_statuses) rewrites a review-gate `failure` to `pending` only for descriptions starting `review: waiting for the review's verdict on <head>,`. It accepts BOTH that old form AND the new form: description starts with the frozen token `Waiting for review-verdict` and contains `Stand-in review: APPROVE <head>`; any other failure description is still treated as a hard failure (tests update tests/unit/scripts/test_pr_landing.py:~1537-1560 and test_pr_arm.py:~726, including a negative case for a look-alike prefix without the head).

New-format bodies are read without parsing presentation words: state from the `<!-- review-verdict: v2 <state> <40hex> -->` marker, decision and open severities from the `<!-- review-protocol: v1 -->` record; thread severity from the `<!-- review-defect: c<n>-D<n> -->` marker joined to the record's open defects. Title-line and section scraping remain only as the fallback for old-format history and record-less bodies (tests for each path).

soundness_merge_digest.py classifies decision and open-defect severities identically for (a) a current-format body, (b) a redesigned-format body, (c) a historical oracle-verdict body, (d) a record-less redesigned body (marker-limit pending) whose findings sit in `
🟠 High · …` blocks, and (e) a redesigned `**Still open**` list with emoji marks; fixtures from real bodies (BenchBox #4062, Theseus #45) and the proposal mockups.

An overridden High finding is classified as an override for both thread formats. An unrecognised bot thread is reported as an 'unclassifiable bot thread' row (never Low, never silently not-an-override), and the digest still completes over the last 90 days of merged history (test plus one dry run, output recorded).
check_comment_cleanup_scope.py accepts a reviewed head whose body uses either the heading or the v2 hidden marker; a body with neither still fails closed (test).
Where the protocol record is present it wins over prose (test with a record-bearing body whose prose disagrees).
docs/internal/review-v2.md describes both formats and states that the protocol record, hidden markers and the frozen status tokens are the contract, not the prose.
PR merged to develop with hosted review-verdict SHIP on the final head and all required checks green, via make pr-arm; merge SHA recorded here.

description:
Theseus will redesign its verdict review body and inline finding threads (verdict-first headline, severity marks, visible finding ids; see theseus-review-output-format-20261110). BenchBox scrapes the current prose in two places, and one of them fails open:
- C1/C3/C4/C5 in _project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py: verdict heading regex, `^Decision: **…**` line, bold open-defect section titles with `^- **<Severity>**` bullets, and thread bodies that must START with `**<Severity>**: `. If the thread title line changes first, overridden High findings silently stop being classified as overrides (fail-open).
- C2 in scripts/check_comment_cleanup_scope.py:1592: `### review-verdict: ([a-z]+) for `<40hex>``.
This item makes every BenchBox reader accept both formats BEFORE any Theseus release writes the new one. The digest reads merged history permanently, so old-format readers stay forever: add the new format, never swap.
Preferred design: the digest already imports Theseus `protocol.decode_marker` (soundness_merge_digest.py ~:613, ~:794); read the decision and each open defect's severity from the `<!-- review-protocol: v1 … -->` record and use markdown scraping only as the fallback for history that lacks it. New-format tokens to accept: headline `### <mark> <DECISION> · …` where DECISION ∈ SHIP | SHIP WITH FIXES | DO NOT SHIP | NOT REVIEWED YET | NOT REVIEWED | REFUSED; hidden marker `<!-- review-verdict: v2 <state> <40hex> -->`; thread first line `<mark> **<Severity>** · D<n> · <title>` (mark ∈ 🔴 🟠 🟡 🔵 ⚪). Severity words are unchanged (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
Guardrails: BenchBox AGENTS.md (worktree from origin/develop via make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight, tests only via make heavy-run after make heavy-status, comment-policy 0, explicit staging, identity Joe Harris, no agent attribution, changelog.d fragment if user-facing, make pr-preflight, make pr-open, hosted SHIP + CI, make pr-arm). These are soundness paths: resolve every review thread on its merits. No live model calls. Do not touch .github/theseus-lock.json or the review callers (other PRs own them).
